hero.description: Full-stack engineer. Thirteen years, from Guatemala, mostly for teams in another time zone. Cloud architecture, conversational AI, and systems that have been running quietly for years.

philosophy.label: 01 — Philosophy
philosophy.quote: “Writing the code is the easy part. The hard part is leaving it so whoever comes next understands why you did it that way.”
philosophy.body: I've spent more than thirteen years building software from Guatemala for teams in other countries. I've worked at every layer: the schema, the API that exposes it, the interface people actually use. None of them forgives neglect, and over the years I learned to give all of them the same respect.
philosophy.globalImpactBody: Remote work with teams across time zones. Python, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Rails.
philosophy.humanSideBody: Guitar and percussion, some bass and ukulele. BMX, and a cat who demands more than he gives. I write clearly and ask before assuming.

items.title: Full-Stack Engineering
items.description: Full product, from the database to the screen. Equally at home at either end.

items.title: Architecture & APIs
items.description: Contracts and protocols so systems understand each other, and keep understanding each other as they change.

items.title: Data & Cloud Systems
items.description: Schemas, pipelines, and infrastructure. The foundation that holds everything else up, especially when nobody is watching.

items.title: Conversational AI
items.description: Chatbots and LLM agents wired into processes that already exist. I started back when every intent had to be trained by hand.

approach.label: The Approach
approach.quote: “Simple is better than complex. The hard part isn't getting to simple: it's not losing it as the system grows.”

contactPage.description: I take on few projects at a time. I work best with people who know where they want to go but not yet where to start: architecture, full builds, and a digital presence that starts out right. When it ships, the code and the access are yours. Tell me what you're building and I'll reply in under 24 hours.
contactPage.messagePlaceholder: Tell me about the project: goals, timeline, current state
contactPage.step1Body: 30 minutes to understand the problem, the constraints, and the real scope. We both leave that call knowing whether the path is the right one.
contactPage.step2Body: Architecture, scope, timeline, and a fixed price. Before a single line is written you know what you're getting and why it's built that way.
contactPage.step3Body: Demos every week on a staging environment. You see the actual progress, not a progress report.
contactPage.step4Body: Deployment, documentation, and a full handover: repositories, access and credentials end up in your name. You leave understanding your system, not depending on me.
